_comment: Unary COSE vectors (ADR 0006 §§3-5, and the decisions on cratestack#1005: audience in the AAD and Cratestack-Nonce for unsigned requests, 2026-09-24; request_kind in the response AAD and a non-empty audience, 2026-09-25; and on cratestack#1006: bound_headers [Idempotency-Key, If-Match] after payload_type, 2026-09-26). Hex throughout. Payload: payment-fixture.json; keys: keys.json. Every case must open with a verifier holding only the key its `key` names (requests: at `verifier_now`, with `skew_secs`). `to_be_signed` is the logical Sig_structure / MAC_structure, even where the implementation computes over it in pieces. ESP256 senders MUST emit low-s: verifiers refuse a high s (neg-esp256-high-s). Every `negative` vector must be refused as `expected` says by a verifier in `mode` holding exactly `verifier_keys`, at `verifier_now` with `skew_secs`.

negative.name: neg-esp256-high-s
negative.why: the valid request's ESP256 signature with s replaced by n - s: it verifies mathematically, but only low-s is accepted, so a third party cannot re-spell a signed message

negative.name: neg-hmac-64-bit-tag-for-a-256-256-key
negative.why: a valid HMAC 256/64 (alg 4) request; the verifier's key for this secret is configured for HMAC 256/256 only

negative.name: neg-kid-7-bytes
negative.why: correctly signed, but the kid is 7 bytes, not 8

negative.name: neg-kid-9-bytes
negative.why: correctly signed, but the kid is 9 bytes, not 8

negative.name: neg-kid-of-another-key
negative.why: signed by ed25519_other under ed25519's kid; the verifier holds both keys, and only a key whose own kid is the header's may verify. A resolver that returns keys by kid already filters ed25519_other out, so there this vector exercises only the signature check; it exercises the opener's own kid-equality check in an implementation whose resolver does not pre-filter by kid

negative.name: neg-wrong-audience
negative.why: a valid request sealed for audience "payments", opened by the service "ledger"

negative.name: neg-kid-in-unprotected-header
negative.why: a valid request with {4: kid} added to the unprotected header, which must be empty

negative.name: neg-alg-minus-8
negative.why: correctly signed Ed25519 under the deprecated polymorphic alg -8 (RFC 9864)

negative.name: neg-trailing-byte
negative.why: a valid request followed by one extra byte

negative.name: neg-response-to-another-get
negative.why: a signed response to an unsigned GET carrying one Cratestack-Nonce, presented as the answer to a GET of the same URL with another nonce

negative.name: neg-tampered-payload
negative.why: a valid request with the last payload byte's low bit flipped

negative.name: neg-tampered-protected-header
negative.why: a valid request with iat's last byte's low bit flipped in the protected header: still well-formed and fresh, but not what was signed

negative.name: neg-aad-route-mismatch
negative.why: a valid request for model.Payment.create, opened as model.Payment.refund

negative.name: neg-schema-sha-mismatch
negative.why: a valid request, opened by a verifier built against another schema (schema_sha all zero)

negative.name: neg-request-digest-mismatch
negative.why: a signed response to rpc-request-sign1-ed25519-cti16, presented as the answer to rpc-request-sign1-ed25519-cti2

negative.name: neg-stale-iat
negative.why: a valid request with iat = 1790000000, opened when the verifier's clock reads iat + skew + 1

negative.name: neg-wrong-tag
negative.why: a valid COSE_Sign1 request re-tagged 17 (COSE_Mac0), opened by a Sign1 verifier

negative.name: neg-non-minimal-cbor-head
negative.why: a valid request whose payload bstr head is re-encoded as 0x59 0x00 0x70 instead of 0x58 0x70; the signature still verifies over the canonical Sig_structure, so only strict parsing refuses it

negative.name: neg-request-kind-mismatch
negative.why: the server's answer to an UNSIGNED request whose Cratestack-Nonce is the first 16 bytes of rpc-request-sign1-ed25519-cti16 and whose body is the rest: its digest equals the signed request's (and the status, 400, is the one the client expects), so only request_kind (0, not 1) tells them apart

negative.expected: reject: 500 local misuse, before the body is read
negative.name: neg-empty-audience
negative.why: correctly signed over an AAD whose audience is the empty string; an empty audience binds no recipient, so the verifier refuses it as misuse before reading the body
